description:
The best Layer 1 and Layer 2 Wi-Fi Channel Analyzer

MetaGeek App performs real-time packet analysis, leveraging beautiful visualizations to remove mental obstacles and promote understanding of technical issues, so the user can resolve network problems. It focuses on real-time 802.11 frame analysis, and can use a Wi-Spy for spectrum analysis to give the user a complete look at their wireless landscape.
Bug Fixes
- Fixed a crash that could occur a few minutes after launch on networks that block MetaGeek's anonymous usage reporting (e.g., some corporate firewalls or proxies)
